name: EPIC 214675824
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 7, 11.8 solar radii and 0.95 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 3,989 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 7, give 0.95 solar masses and 11.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,721 K at its surface.
